tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: REs shall ensure that the instructions are implemented in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: In the case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be ensured on the next review/ renewal date falling on or after April 1, 2024, but not later than June 30, 2024.
